items.title: "Wooden Joe" Nicholas Interview, 1956-11-12
items.q: Him and Tiff went together then, did they?

ctx.x: I never did know why. Somebody told me it was because of his knee that he limp. I didn't know. I didn't think it would be that, but I wondered.
Him and Tiff went together then, did they?
Who was the drummer? Do you remember?
